name: com.photonvrplus.core
description: Photon VR Plus: a rebuilt, drop-in replacement for PhotonVR (fchb1239) for Photon PUN 2 VR games. Includes App ID + Voice App ID settings, Photon Voice with push-to-talk, spatial presets and mute lists, a networked player prefab with cosmetic slots, a cosmetic registry and tints, grabbable objects, nameplates, room codes, spectators, master-client and ownership validation, a banned-word filter, saving with an optional PlayFab manager (encrypted Title ID, login, currency, items and purchases), and a debug overlay. It keeps the original class names, fields and cosmetic keys. Requires PUN 2 and Photon Voice 2 from the Asset Store, plus TextMeshPro.

author.name: Photon VR Plus contributors (original PhotonVR by fchb1239)

samples.description: Manager, OnGUI lobby (public room, private codes, spectator) and debug overlay.
Lobby plus a floor and networked grabbable cubes.
